<?php
include_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Skip the WooCommerce onboarding wizard and the setup task list.
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'completed' => true, 'skipped' => true ) );
update_option( 'woocommerce_task_list_hidden', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_task_list_appearance_hidden', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_admin_notices', array() );

// Let visitors reach the storefront instead of the "coming soon" page.
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );

// An Estonian store, so the plugin's invoice and VAT paths have sane values.
update_option( 'blogname', 'e-Financials Demo Store' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_address', 'Tartu mnt 1' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_city', 'Tallinn' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_postcode', '10145' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_default_country', 'EE' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_currency', 'EUR' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_calc_taxes', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_prices_include_tax', 'yes' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout', 'yes' );

WC_Tax::_insert_tax_rate( array(
	'tax_rate_country'  => 'EE',
	'tax_rate'          => '22.0000',
	'tax_rate_name'     => 'KM',
	'tax_rate_priority' => 1,
	'tax_rate_shipping' => 1,
	'tax_rate_class'    => '',
) );

<?php
include_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Demo catalogue.
$catalogue = array(
	array( 'Raamatupidamise kiirkursus', 'EF-COURSE', '149.00', 'Ühepäevane kursus e-Arveldaja kasutajatele.' ),
	array( 'Beanie', 'EF-BEANIE', '18.00', 'Warm demo beanie.' ),
	array( 'Hoodie', 'EF-HOODIE', '45.00', 'Demo hoodie with a logo.' ),
	array( 'Sunglasses', 'EF-SUNGLASSES', '90.00', 'Demo sunglasses.' ),
	array( 'Cap', 'EF-CAP', '16.00', 'Demo cap.' ),
	array( 'Belt', 'EF-BELT', '55.00', 'Demo leather belt.' ),
);

$product_ids = array();

foreach ( $catalogue as $item ) {
	list( $name, $sku, $price, $description ) = $item;

	$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$product->set_name( $name );
	$product->set_sku( $sku );
	$product->set_regular_price( $price );
	$product->set_description( $description );
	$product->set_short_description( $description );
	$product->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
	$product->set_tax_status( 'taxable' );
	$product->set_status( 'publish' );
	$product_ids[] = $product->save();
}

update_option( 'ef_demo_product_ids', $product_ids );

<?php
include_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';

$product_ids = get_option( 'ef_demo_product_ids', array() );

if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
	return;
}

$customer_id = username_exists( 'demo_customer' );

if ( ! $customer_id ) {
	$customer_id = wc_create_new_customer( 'kadri@example.com', 'demo_customer', 'demo-password' );
}

$address = array(
	'first_name' => 'Kadri',
	'last_name'  => 'Tamm',
	'company'    => 'Näidis OÜ',
	'email'      => 'kadri@example.com',
	'phone'      => '+372 5555 0100',
	'address_1'  => 'Pärnu mnt 12',
	'city'       => 'Tallinn',
	'postcode'   => '10148',
	'country'    => 'EE',
);

$demo_orders = array(
	array( 'completed', array( 0 => 1, 2 => 2 ) ),
	array( 'processing', array( 1 => 3, 4 => 1 ) ),
	array( 'on-hold', array( 3 => 1 ) ),
);

foreach ( $demo_orders as $demo_order ) {
	list( $status, $lines ) = $demo_order;

	$order = wc_create_order( array( 'customer_id' => is_wp_error( $customer_id ) ? 0 : $customer_id ) );

	foreach ( $lines as $index => $quantity ) {
		if ( ! isset( $product_ids[ $index ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$product = wc_get_product( $product_ids[ $index ] );

		if ( $product ) {
			$order->add_product( $product, $quantity );
		}
	}

	$order->set_address( $address, 'billing' );
	$order->set_address( $address, 'shipping' );
	$order->set_payment_method_title( 'Bank transfer' );
	$order->calculate_totals();
	$order->update_status( $status, 'Demo order created by the Playground blueprint.' );
}

delete_option( 'ef_demo_product_ids' );
